meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 这个技能让 NanoClaw 能接入 Matrix 聊天平台。它会自动复制并注册所需的连接代码、安装指定版本的组件、修正代码兼容问题,然后构建和测试;通过后,引导你配置一个独立的机器人账号,用于私聊和群聊消息。
howto.when: 当你想为 NanoClaw 连接 Matrix 聊天平台时触发。例如明确要求“添加 Matrix”或“设置 Matrix 机器人”,技能就会执行安装步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 聊天平台。
say.note: 会执行复制代码、装组件和构建测试。

say.text: 请添加 Matrix 频道,并配置机器人凭据。
say.note: 之后会引导你填写 homeserver 等信息。

say.text: 我想通过 Matrix 收发消息,请设置好。
say.note: 技能会改动代码并提示你输入账号或令牌。

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix channel support to NanoClaw. It copies and registers the Matrix adapter, installs a pinned dependency, patches ESM imports, runs build and tests, then walks you through credentials for a dedicated bot account.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect NanoClaw to Matrix, e.g. “add Matrix” or “set up a Matrix bot”.

say_en.text: Please connect NanoClaw to Matrix chat.
say_en.note: It copies the adapter and runs build/tests.

say_en.text: Add Matrix channel and configure bot credentials.
say_en.note: It will prompt for homeserver details.

say_en.text: I want to send and receive messages via Matrix.
say_en.note: The skill modifies code and asks for an account or token.
